races.paceDynamic: No More Bolero will lead from the start with minimal pressure, as only Rupert The Prince shows prominent tendencies while the rest are hold-up horses. This creates a sustainable tempo that allows No More Bolero to dictate terms through steady sectionals without being harassed. The lack of early pace pressure means the leaders can save energy for the finish, while the five hold-up horses will need to rely on a strong gallop from the back. This race shape strongly favours the front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic and position themselves ideally.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If No More Bolero gets an easy lead without pressure from Rupert The Prince
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian allowing the leader to quicken off slow fractions while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. No More Bolero's recent winning form and tactical advantage becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the sustained pace allows hold-up horses to close strongly in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up brigade pay off as they finish fastest past tiring leaders. Marbuzet's recent good form and Scottish Dancer's last-start win make them the beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Rupert The Prince presses No More Bolero early and creates genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo suits horses that can travel just off the pace without being too far back. Rupert The Prince's lighter weight and recent good form helps him capitalize on forcing the issue.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If No More Bolero goes too slow early then quickens dramatically turning for home
scenarios.body: The field bunches up and it becomes a sprint finish where positioning matters most. The apprentice jockeys struggle with tactical decisions allowing more experienced combinations to benefit.

races.paceDynamic: Crimson Blaze will take this field along as the clear pace-setter, with The Can Can Queen, Fern Clyde and Tricky Jenny tracking in behind forming the early prominent group. With limited early speed in the field and Crimson Blaze unlikely to be pressured, she can dictate a steady tempo that suits her style. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this becomes a tactical affair where positioning and timing matter more than raw speed. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as kick and finishing speed will be at a premium in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Crimson Blaze maintains a steady gallop without serious early pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets first run and the race becomes about who can quickest respond when she kicks. Prominent runners with tactical speed are perfectly positioned to strike, while hold-up horses face an impossible task from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If The Can Can Queen or Fern Clyde challenge Crimson Blaze for the early lead creating pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo softens up the leaders and creates opportunities for those tracking in fourth or fifth position. Horses with a turn of foot who avoided the early battle can capitalize on a true pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling slow with all prominent runners content to wait
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole where raw finishing speed trumps positioning. This suits any horse with untapped ability who can produce a sustained late kick regardless of early position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Breakdown
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to make their move simultaneously in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The race fragments with horses coming from all angles, creating confusion and potentially allowing an outsider to slip through. Horses with experienced jockeys who can find racing room benefit most.

races.paceDynamic: Popeye Doyle will lead from the front with Spirit Catcher and Poet's Dawn providing early support, but this won't create a searching gallop with just one confirmed front-runner. The moderate early pace will allow the large hold-up contingent to get into contention, but the final two furlongs will see sustained pressure as multiple hold-up horses try to make their move simultaneously. With 11 of 14 runners employing hold-up tactics and only gentle early fractions expected, this race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably emerge in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Poet's Dawn and Spirit Catcher can secure good early positions behind Popeye Doyle
scenarios.body: The steady early pace suits their style perfectly and they avoid the inevitable traffic jam as 11 hold-up horses converge in the final quarter-mile. Their tactical advantage proves decisive in a race where position trumps pure ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent gets badly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: Multiple runners with similar tactics create a wall of horses that prevents several from getting clear runs, allowing one or two to find daylight and capitalize. The winner emerges more through luck than judgment as traffic determines the outcome.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Popeye Doyle faces no early pressure and gets soft fractions
scenarios.body: With minimal pace pressure early, the leader can dictate terms and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organizing their challenge. The lack of early pace-setters means no one can put genuine pressure on until too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one hold-up horse gets the perfect trip while others are stopped
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, superior ability shines through as a patient ride finds the right gaps. The winner needs everything to fall right but has the class to capitalize when it does.

races.paceDynamic: Shallow will control this race from the front with minimal early pressure, as the only confirmed pace-setter faces a field dominated by hold-up horses. Beaujolais Nouveau, Saffron Dandy and Lebron Power may track in second but none are natural tearaways. The lack of pace pressure means Shallow can dictate fractions and kick for home when ready, while the six hold-up horses (Powdering, Alpine Girl, Anaisa, Cotai Belle, Space Bear) face the nightmare scenario of fighting for racing room behind a slow early gallop. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shallow Controls Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Shallow gets an easy lead and comfortable fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: Shallow dictates the pace without pressure and has enough left to resist late challenges, while the hold-up brigade struggle to make ground from too far back. The lack of early pace becomes decisive as front-runners dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes extremely slow with Shallow barely cantering
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge from the 2f pole with the hold-up horses getting their ideal scenario of a sprint finish. Superior class and turn of foot become crucial as traffic problems sort themselves out.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Beaujolais Nouveau or Saffron Dandy press Shallow harder than expected
scenarios.body: The increased pace pressure compromises Shallow's kick while still being fast enough to blunt the hold-up horses' finishing efforts. Those tracking in second and third get the best of both worlds.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems resolve perfectly and one hold-up horse gets a dream run
scenarios.body: Despite the unfavourable pace shape, superior class tells as one hold-up runner weaves through to win with the fastest finishing sectional. Requires racing luck and jockey brilliance.

races.paceDynamic: Quirke On Parole is the sole confirmed front runner in this field and will be allowed to dictate terms from the front without early pressure. With Daring Leader and Penny Ghent likely to sit prominent but not challenge early, Quirke On Parole can establish a comfortable rhythm through steady fractions. The predominance of hold-up horses (Barleybrown, Volenti, Little Ted, Oilisa, I Can Boogy, Balqaa, Ring Of Gold, Woodleigh, Far Ahead, Haaf A Diamond, Arranmore) will create a bunched field tracking the leader, setting up a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, as the hold-up brigade will face traffic problems in a cavalry charge finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scores
scenarios.trigger: If Quirke On Parole maintains his jumping and gets soft fractions uncontested to the home turn.
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old can kick clear when the field comes under pressure and hold off the late charge. His class edge shows when not having to battle for the lead early.

scenarios.body: They avoid the traffic that will engulf the hold-up horses while getting first run on the weakening leader. Positioning proves crucial in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or the prominent horses falter, opening up clear running lanes.
scenarios.body: One of the better hold-up horses like Oilisa or I Can Boogy can unleash their finishing kick through a clear passage. Class tells when they get racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Quirke On Parole goes too slowly and the field remains tightly bunched throughout.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the home turn where any horse can win on the day. Form becomes less relevant in a scrambled finish.

races.paceDynamic: Ellie's de Vega will take this field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting what should be a comfortable pace with no early pressure expected. Simba's Pride and Peggy Boo may sit prominent but neither are aggressive pace-forcers, leaving Ellie's de Vega largely uncontested through the early stages. The majority of this field comprises hold-up horses (Pivotal Terms, Vega's Virtue, Gunalt Wavelength, Hares Bredth, Tenor's Inn, What A Tahoo) who will be relying on the pace to come back to them in the final furlong. This sustainable early gallop strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable late traffic problems that will face the large contingent of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ellie's de Vega gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear entering the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up brigade get caught in traffic behind the slow early pace. Her recent consistent placed efforts on good ground suggest she can sustain the gallop when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Weaves Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one of the back markers finds a clear run through traffic.
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up performer benefits from a truly-run pace and superior finishing kick when finding daylight. The sheer weight of numbers tracking the leader creates gaps for a well-positioned finisher to exploit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Simba's Pride or Peggy Boo pressure Ellie's de Vega early and create genuine pace.
scenarios.body: The early battle sets up a competitive gallop that brings multiple hold-up horses into contention with superior finishing speed. Traffic problems remain but the stronger pace allows more horses realistic winning chances.
